Grob block

Source: R/content.R
bb_grob.Rd

Wraps any grob, gTree or gtable, drawn to fill the space it is given.

Usage

bb_grob(g, height = NULL)

Arguments

g

A grob.

height

`grid::unit` or inches; `NULL` for flexible; `"auto"` to measure `grid::grobHeight(g)` (for grobs with an absolute height). A numeric `"height_in"` attribute on `g` is used when `height` is `NULL`.

Value

A block.

Examples

bb_grob(grid::rectGrob(gp = grid::gpar(fill = "grey90")), height = 0.3)
#> <bb_grob>
